The root project DOI and the 3.1.0 citation DOI have explicitly different roles, so their difference is not an identifier inconsistency.

Collection, feature extraction, clinical labeling, named processing software, and missingness behavior are described with substantial technical detail.
The stated enrollment targets of 10,000 and 30,000 are disclosed as conflicting source targets, not confused with the current count of 833 participants.
Named processing software satisfies E8.4 through its transformation role; capture applications and hosting platforms are not needed to earn that point.
Platform access and publication are explicit in the landing page, access instructions, and citation, supporting E2.3 and E10.1 without requiring duplicate download_url or publisher fields.
No applicability exclusions were inferred from the record. All conditional predicates remain unknown under the empty caller context.
